faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech/M.E. degree in Manufacturing/Production/CAD-CAM/Design. GATE/NET qualification is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37000 plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this BITS Pilani recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position, offering an opportunity for research experience in a government-funded project.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the BITS Pilani campus located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad campus, Telangana.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.
